figures.title: From specification to usable handoff
figures.desc: The five-stage production workflow: specify the work product, build it in the real surface, inspect direct evidence, make the release decision, and leave a usable handoff.
figures.caption: Read left to right: direct checks drive the release decision; the handoff records what ships and what remains.
figures.transcript: One: Specify the artifact, audience, sources, acceptance checks, and stop condition. Two: Build the durable artifact in its real surface. Three: Check it by opening, running, comparing, counting, tracing, scoring, or diffing. Four: Decide release, fix, or hold from the evidence. Five: Deliver the path, decision, evidence, residual risk and owner, and next run.
